betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Fast-forward a red giant into a §9neutron star§r, and stop it going supernova. The Core Collapse is the hardest event yet: read all of this before you start.

§5§lBEFORE§r
- the T3 milestones;
- the §9Galactic Upgrade Core§r in escrow (Condensate Assembler, 32,000 L Entangled Hyperdense Stellar Mixture);
- the §9spiral arms§r built (stack 4: 4,981 Galactic Shell Plating) and compression at tier 4;
- Arcturus lit and Stable;
- buffered:§9 5,000 L HSM§r (the seed), up to§9 90,000 L molten SpaceTime§r (the shock absorber) and the neutron star's first cycle;
-§9 94,000 L Tachyon Rich Temporal Fluid§r on hand for the Field sockets.
Then swap in §9Star Chart: Neutron Star§r.

§5§l1 §lFAST-FORWARD§r (about 16 min) Dose Tachyon Rich Temporal Fluid into the Field sockets, up to 100 L/s. The core climbs from 0.50 to§9 1.44 SM§r over 94,000 L. The envelope swells P and Θ as it goes, and your T3 rig must hold.

§5§l2 §lBOUNCE§r The HSM becomes the neutron seed, Integrity drops 20, and a shock of §9+150§r hits P and Θ.
- Every§9 1,000 L molten SpaceTime§r buffered cancels 1 point, up to 90: the shock is then +60.
- Any gauge above +100 after the shock is §c§lSUPERNOVA§r: Arcturus, the Time fluid, the HSM and the SpaceTime are lost. The core stays in escrow.
So bring P and Θ §lbelow §l+40§r before the bounce. The scanner predicts both.

§5§l3 §lSETTLE§r The neutron star lights at P 0, Θ +60, Ω +30. Get it Stable for 60 seconds in a row within 180 s (Super Coolant pulls Θ down). T4 is then yours.

§5§lTHE §lNEUTRON §lSTAR§r
- No fusion, so no Hydrogen or Helium:§9 144 L molten SpaceTime§r a cycle and 9.66 × 10¹² EU (about 4 A MAX) hold it.
- Set the §9HSM feed§r in the GUI (0-1.5 L/s, default 0.694). §9White Dwarf Matter = 3.6864 L per L of HSM fed§r, about 9,200 L an hour at the default.
- The feed pushes P, Θ and the spin §9Ω§r up. Ω runs away by itself, and §9glitches§r kick it +20 every 15-30 minutes §lwithout §lwarning§r.
- Trims, up to 10 units a second: Spatially Enlarged Fluid (100 L) P −2; molten SpaceTime (100 L) P +2; Super Coolant (100 L) Θ −3; molten Purified Tengam (36 L, up to 5) Θ +1, Ω −4.
- If it breaches, it collapses into a black hole. With T4 unlocked, a dark Eye holding the Neutron Star chart relights the §9neutron star itself§r at T4 from a §9Stellar Ignition Charge§r and a 5,000 L HSM neutron seed (plus one cycle buffered and its EU). No Arcturus, no Core Collapse re-run, no core.

[note]The Deep Dark planet runs at T4, and one Deep Dark run is a T4 → T5 milestone.[/note]

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r you hold the core and the chart (HOLD → CLAIM → INSTALL: claim before the core goes into escrow).
